entry.title: Hexadecimal Data Encoding Issue in SAP Tables STXH & STXL During SLT Replication
entry.content:
When SAP SLT replicates the STXL table to ADLS, the CLUSTD field defined in SAP as type LRAW (Long Raw / binary cluster data) is transmitted and stored as a raw hexadecimal binary string. This field contains the actual text payload for a given text object, but it is compressed and encoded using SAP's internal cluster storage mechanism. The hexadecimal representation in ADLS is not directly readable by analytics tools without a dedicated decoding step.
The STXH table provides the text header metadata including the text name (TDOBJECT, TDNAME), language (TDSPRAS), and text ID (TDID) while STXL stores the corresponding lines of text in the CLUSTD field. Without successfully decoding CLUSTD, it is not possible to reconstruct the original readable text for analysis.
